rationale: Based on the historical execution data for the 'build' job in '.github/workflows/unit-test.yml', the job consistently completes within 320 to 408 seconds (approx. 5.3 to 6.8 minutes). The pattern suggests using a buffer multiplier (e.g., 1.1x) on historical data. Applying a 10-minute timeout (600s) provides a safe headroom above the observed maximum while preventing indefinite hangs, adhering to the principle of deriving limits from successful history.
